text: {"lessons":["I sold several positions to realize gains, but a gain alone is not a reason to sell; weigh each stock’s prospects and my overall allocation.","I held Stock C through a large loss before selling, a reminder to set sensible review criteria rather than let the pain of realizing a loss keep me from reassessing a position.","I rarely trade, and many periods passed without a trade; I should avoid reacting to short-term account swings and act only when a clear reason supports it."]}
